t.zh: 岛上的人要么是骑士，永远说真话；要么是无赖，永远说假话。
t.en: Everyone on the island is a knight, who always tells the truth, or a knave, who always lies.

t.zh: 岛民说一句话，「他是骑士」就和他的话<wiki-ref to="equivalence"></wiki-ref>，写成 ↔。翻译见<level-ref to="e-says"></level-ref>，证明器上拆开 ↔ 见<level-ref to="iffUse"></level-ref>。
t.en: When an islander says something, “he is a knight” is in <wiki-ref to="equivalence"></wiki-ref> with what he says, written ↔. You translated this in <level-ref to="e-says"></level-ref>, and took ↔ apart on the prover in <level-ref to="iffUse"></level-ref>.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="liar"></wiki-ref>在岛上的样子。
after.en: This is the island’s form of the <wiki-ref to="liar"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 岛民 a 说：「我是无赖。」把这句话接成电路：a 的话和他的身份相符的那几行，输出真。
brief.en: An islander a says: “I am a knave.” Wire it as a circuit: it outputs true on the rows where what a says fits what a is.

hint.en: “I am a knave” is “¬a is a knight”.

t.zh: 证明谁也说不出「我是无赖」：从它的翻译推出矛盾。
t.en: Prove that nobody can say “I am a knave”: derive a contradiction from its translation.

hint.zh: 先把 ↔ 拆成两个方向。
hint.en: First split the ↔ into its two directions.

hint.zh: 「¬a 是骑士」就是「a 是骑士 → ⊥」。
hint.en: “¬a is a knight” is “a is a knight → ⊥”.
